title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.6.14 security update
description: Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.6.14 addresses a critical security vulnerability (CVE-2026-18963) that allows unauthenticated attackers to take over accounts by bypassing the reset-credentials flow. This update replaces version 7.6.13 and includes bug fixes and enhancements. The vulnerability is related to improper handling of the password reset process, enabling unauthorized account takeover.
